scope: Three papers excluded from lexical pattern-development fixtures; source passages and 18 reference answers frozen before live extraction. Himes is also the experimental source of the airway demonstration.
reference_method: Source inspection with passage anchors. Reference answers are review labels, not an independent participant study.

questions.question: What is the primary RNA-seq GEO accession, excluding secondary microarray data?
questions.reason: Secondary microarray accessions are not the primary experiment.

questions.question: Which program performed the primary RNA-seq differential expression test?
questions.reason: Cufflinks quantifies transcripts; Cuffdiff tests differential expression.

questions.question: Which program aligned the primary RNA-seq reads?
questions.reason: The original experiment and the later workflow have different alignment context.

questions.question: How many biological donors contributed to each primary RNA-seq condition?
questions.reason: qRT-PCR triplicates and three-donor validation are distinct from four RNA-seq donors.

questions.question: What numerical minimum total raw gene count filter is reported for the primary RNA-seq analysis?
questions.reason: No such raw-count filter is reported in the supplied primary-analysis text.

questions.question: Was TMM explicitly used for the primary Cuffdiff RNA-seq analysis? Return TMM only if supported, otherwise null.
questions.reason: Secondary microarray processing does not establish a primary RNA-seq TMM step.

questions.question: What is the primary ENA project accession?
questions.reason: Project accession is distinct from the individual experiment accession.

questions.question: What organism was used in the primary highly replicated experiment?
questions.reason: Mouse and human studies in the introduction are prior comparisons.

questions.question: How many biological replicates were originally sequenced per condition before quality control?
questions.reason: Original sample count differs from retained or recommended counts.

questions.question: How many wild-type biological replicates remained after quality control?
questions.reason: Wild-type and mutant retained sample counts differ.

questions.question: How many mutant biological replicates remained after quality control?
questions.reason: Forty-two in the abstract describes the common comparison size, not retained mutant count.

questions.question: What single normalization method was applied to every differential-expression tool? Return null if methods differ.
questions.reason: Default normalization differs across tools; DESeq normalization defines the separate reference fold changes.

questions.question: What is the GEO accession of the main mixture experiment?
questions.reason: The earlier accession belongs to the pilot.

questions.question: What is the GEO accession of the pilot experiment?
questions.reason: Pilot and mixture experiments must remain distinct.

questions.question: How many samples must meet the main expression filter before differential analysis?
questions.reason: The main filter uses three samples; a later secondary analysis uses four.

questions.question: How many genes remain after the primary CPM > 1 filter?
questions.reason: The lower-cutoff sensitivity analysis retains 16131 genes.

questions.question: Which normalization is used specifically by DESeq2?
questions.reason: The nearby overall description says TMM, but DESeq2 uses median ratio.

questions.question: What exact R model formula is printed for the main differential analysis? Return null if no formula is present.
questions.reason: A plausible formula must not be invented from a narrative design.
